label: For "Healthcare Contract Compliance Monitoring": Monitor operational and commercial evidence against contractual obligations and service levels, so owners see breach risks and remediation tasks early and no formal breach notice is sent without their decision. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Letting the model decide breach.
